svg.title: ttt-titans
svg.desc: Titans memory update. Toy trace over 16 tokens: momentary surprise (gradient norm) spikes at token 6; with momentum eta = 0.7 the write keeps going for several tokens. Three placements: MAC prepends memory read-outs as tokens to segment attention, MAG gates sliding-window attention with the memory branch, MAL stacks the memory layer before SWA. Reported ablation (Table 5): long-context accuracy MAC 97.95, MAG 96.70, MAL 96.91, memory alone 92.68, linear memory 85.34, without momentum 87.12, without weight decay 85.60.
